title: docs(onboarding): stale cross-reference and dangling ONBOARDING.md links across 4 files
body:
## Background

**Origin**: flagged during the issue-mediated bootstrap of this template into `kurone-kito/kurone-kito` (kurone-kito/kurone-kito#29, merged), tracked upstream via #2973 items 8, 9, and 11. Verified 2026-09-14 against this repository's current source, with the scope widened by one file versus the original report (see note below).

**Files**:
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/issue-mediated-bootstrap.md` (~line 228, stale reference; ~line 10-13, dangling link)
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/agent-entry-and-verification.md` (~line 10-12, dangling link)
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/optional-host-setup.md` (~line 578-579, dangling link)
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/project-tuning.md` (~lines 11, 28, 124, dangling link)

**Problem** (two related reference-hygiene gaps):

1. `issue-mediated-bootstrap.md` (~L228) references a `"Do not draft this"` heading/anchor/quoted rule that doesn't exist anywhere in the file (no matching heading or exact phrase); the related prose actually lives at ~lines 300-314 with no matching heading to point at.
2. Four files carry the same class of dangling local-path reference (`../../ONBOARDING.md` or `idd-template/ONBOARDING.md`-style), which 404s once only `docs/` -- not the full `idd-template/` tree -- is imported downstream: `issue-mediated-bootstrap.md` (~L10-13), `agent-entry-and-verification.md` (~L10-12), `optional-host-setup.md` (~L578-579, `../../ONBOARDING.md#dry-run--readiness-assessment`), and `project-tuning.md` (~lines 11, 28, 124). The original report described `project-tuning.md` as "already fixed" via a downstream adopter's local divergence, but verification found the identical unfixed pattern still present in this canonical repository -- that fix was only ever applied locally downstream, never upstreamed here, so the real remaining scope is these 4 files, not 2.

## Proposed change

1. Correct `issue-mediated-bootstrap.md`'s stale cross-reference to point at the actual prose location (~lines 300-314) or add the missing heading it expects.
2. Replace each dangling local-path reference in all 4 files with a released tag or pinned-commit URL, consistent with this repository's own "keep imports pinned" convention used elsewhere in these same documents.

## Acceptance criteria
- `issue-mediated-bootstrap.md`'s `"Do not draft this"` cross-reference points at real, existing content.
- All 4 named files' `ONBOARDING.md`-family references resolve to a released tag or pinned-commit URL instead of a dangling local relative path.
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` and `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` pass on all 4 updated files.

## Groom disposition

Maintainer decision (Groom hearing, 2026-09-15): confirm this issue as full-autopilot-ready. The scope is repository-local, the acceptance criteria are deterministic, and no human coordination remains after the hearing.

## Candidate files

- `idd-template/ONBOARDING.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/agent-entry-and-verification.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/issue-mediated-bootstrap.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/optional-host-setup.md`
- `idd-template/docs/onboarding/project-tuning.md`

Refs #3027 (non-blocking)

Issue `#3027` puts this same onboarding surface under a
`bundleBudgets` size budget measured at its own implementation time, so
these two can land in either order; neither needs to wait for the other.

---
